# Sell the lot whole, or split it?

> Paste the items in a bulk lot and a whole-lot offer and see whether listing item by item earns more after fees, shipping and your time, which lines to list and which to sell on in bulk. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/lot-split-calculator/)
- [Should you sell a bulk lot whole or split it? The math](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/lot-split-calculator/should-i-sell-a-bulk-lot-whole-or-split-it.html)
